description: This file defines logging functions for the lighttpd server, including initialization, cleanup, writing logs with optional timestamps, and splitting log lines.

methods.name: void li_log_init(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Initializes the server logging settings, setting log type, levels, file descriptor, and creating timestamp and log line buffers.

methods.name: void li_log_clean(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for timestamp cache and log line buffers.

methods.name: void li_log_write(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a log message with optional timestamp, handles log levels, and outputs to standard error.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * prefix)
methods.description: Splits a block of text into lines and logs each line with a prefix.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines_(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Same as 'li_log_split_lines' but accepts a format string for the prefix.
